description: Step 3 of the fz-sc8.197 page. A table in the extern lowering (native_codegen/prim.rs): fz_op_{add,sub,mul}_ii as overflow-checked add/sub/mul, fz_op_{lt,lte,gt,gte,eq,neq}_ii as compares. Measured in a spike on #592: distiller no measurable change, byte walk -1.2%, index walk -3.0%; overflow output identical. The interpreter and the JIT must agree (three-path parity).

comments.text: No longer blocked by fz-sc8.212 (parked). The splice (emit_extern_call) knows which extern it emits; the instruction table keys on that. Measured on top of the splice: distiller no change, p1b -1.2%, p2b -3.0%.

title: Integer arithmetic and comparison externs are emitted as instructions
